arguments.text: Great start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course-fitted push; strongly negative = extra drag (rudder weed?) rather than current

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power gives vs fitted current: drag or current change
shaft power well under CP with reserve in hand

arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Start was hot: pod reserve 51 pct at 1 min, shaft 326 W vs CP 204. Cued ease at 1.0 min (no pace target: current flips each leg). Aim: shaft near CP (~200-210 W) mid race, reserve ~40-60 pct, spend it in last 1.5-2 km (finish cue ~1500 m left). Watches: pod_reserve_low, extra_drag (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.25 -> consider clear_rudder), too_easy. CP may be 10-25 pct off: check cp_implied / fade later.

text: Cued ease after a hot start (pod reserve 51 pct at 1 min); set watches for low reserve, extra drag, and too-easy pacing; wrote plan note.

arguments.text: Ease more now. Reserve is nearly spent. Long smooth strokes.

2.0 min: pod reserve 7 pct (boat 14), shaft still 295 W after first ease cue. Cued ease again at 2.0 min. Next: check shaft drops to ~200 W; if reserve stays near 0 and speed does not fade, CP may be set too low (watch cp_implied / fade).

text: Cued a firmer ease: pod reserve at 7 pct with shaft power still 45 pct above critical power.
no cue: shaft power has settled at critical power (201 vs 204 W), reserve slowly refilling, pace on the sustainable line.

arguments.text: 8 min, leg 2 (against current -0.15): shaft 208 W ~ CP 204, pod reserve 11 pct, no fade (+1.3). Paddler says 7/10 all good I have plenty. Suspicion: CP may be set low. Test: if shaft >= CP for 10+ min with reserve ~0 and no fade, cp_implied appears -> consider set_critical_power upward (max 3 uses). Until then no push cue.

text: no cue: paddler at critical power, no fade, feels 7/10 with plenty; noted suspicion that critical power is set low, to test against cp_implied and fade.

arguments.message: speed at same rate fading: real reserve may be empty or drag

arguments.text: Looking strong. Lift the effort a touch, keep it smooth.

11 min: 8+ min at shaft ~206 W (just above CP 204) with pod reserve under 15 pct (now 6), no fade (+0.7). Cued a small push at 11.0 min as a CP test. Watch fade_check (fade_pct < -2.5 for 45 s). If no fade by ~16 min at higher shaft power with model reserve at 0: raise cp_shaft to the held power. If fade: ease back to ~CP.

text: Cued a small push as a test of whether critical power is set too low (no fade after 8 min at critical power on a near-empty modelled reserve); set a fade watch.

arguments.message: shaft power sagging below CP unasked: paddler may be truly spent

arguments.text: 14 min: push cue lifted shaft only to ~211 W. Pod reserve model hit 0 at ~13 min. No fade yet (+4 pct, but leg 3 current may be under-fitted: push_local 0.24 vs push_along 0.14, so speed_water may be inflated). Test continues: if shaft holds >= 208 W to ~18 min without sag (watch shaft_drop) and paddler OK, raise cp_shaft to ~215-220.

text: no cue: continuing the critical-power test (shaft 211 W on a modelled empty reserve, no fade yet); added a watch for an unasked drop in shaft power.

arguments.reason: Since 3 min the modelled reserve has been under 15 pct and at 0 from 13 min, yet shaft 205-212 W held with no fade and paddler reports 4/10, plenty. Test CP looks about 10 pct low; first step up.

arguments.text: You have more in you. Lift the pressure and hold it.

17 min: shaft drifted back to ~200 W after push faded; paddler 4/10 plenty. Raised CP (1st of 3 uses): shaft 204->225, boat 135->149. Cued push at 17.1 min. Target now shaft ~225 W. If shaft holds 225+ with no sag/fade and paddler still easy by ~23 min, consider 2nd raise (~240). If shaft_drop or fade alerts: ease. Push cues fade in minutes: re-cue as needed.

text: Raised critical power by about 10 pct (evidence: no fade on a modelled-empty reserve, paddler 4/10) and cued a push to lift shaft power toward 225 W.

arguments.text: Into the current, lift to 2:37 pace and hold it.

20 min, leg 4 (against current -0.17): plain push cues only lift shaft ~5-8 W and fade within ~3 min (now 206 W vs new CP 225). Cued push with ground pace 157 s/500 (= ~3.37 m/s water, ~226 W shaft) at 20.0 min. After the turn (~25 min) current helps: a with-current ground pace for 226 W is ~143 s/500.

text: Cued a push with a 2:37 ground-pace target into the current, because plain push cues barely moved shaft power toward the corrected critical power of 225 W.

arguments.message: shaft power sagging below the ~205 W the paddler has held: may be truly spent

text: no cue: alert was an artefact of raising critical power (threshold moved to 209 W); reset the sag watch to a fixed 192 W and let the 2:37 pace cue act.

arguments.text: Strong to the turn, then keep this pressure with the current.

23 min: paddler settles ~205-213 W shaft whatever the cue; each push gives ~+7 W for ~3 min. Pace target 157 not reached (159). Replaced the 157 pace target with a plain push at 23.2 min so they do not ease to 2:37 after the turn (with current). Plan: re-push every ~3-4 min (cues left 14), keep 3 for the finish; consider an early finish (~2000 m out) since true reserve likely bigger.

text: Cued a plain push to the turn, replacing the upstream pace target so the paddler does not ease after turning with the current.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at 23.4 min: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 8750 m.

arguments.message: cue gate open again: tell the paddler the new finish distance (8750 m)

arguments.text: 23.4 min: RADIO race committee: course shortened by one leg, finish at 8750 m (was 10000). set_race_distance 8750 done. MUST cue tell with distance_left_m (8750 minus distance_m) as soon as the gate opens (~24.3 min, watch tell_new_finish). Finish sprint now ~1500-2000 m before 8750 (i.e. at ~6750-7250 m). Remaining after the turn: leg 5 north (with current) to 6250, leg 6 south to 7500, leg 7 north to 8750.

text: Set race distance to 8750 m after the committee radio; cue gate closed for 50 s, so set a watch to wake me to tell the paddler the new finish.

arguments.text: Course shortened one leg. Finish is now 3.9 km away.

24.4 min at 4834 m: told paddler finish is 3900 m away (new finish 8750 m). Done. Next: finish cue at ~7000-7250 m (1500-1750 m left); meanwhile push cues every ~3-4 min. Shaft 215 W, pod reserve 33 pct (CP 225 model).

arguments.message: 1850 m to the 8750 m finish: decide when to cue the final sprint

text: Told the paddler the finish is now 3.9 km away (course shortened to 8750 m) and set a watch to wake me 1850 m from the finish to time the sprint.

arguments.text: Tailwind now. Ride it and lift the pressure again.

26.2 min RADIO escort: wind filling from the south 8-12 kn = tailwind on northbound legs 5 and 7, headwind on leg 6 (southbound, 6250-7500 m) plus current against there. push_local 0.28 > push_along 0.16 (fit lags the wind). Shaft back to 205 W; cued push 26.2 min. Plan: push again ~29 min; at leg 6 start (6250 m) push hard upwind (most valuable); finish cue ~7250-7500 m. Pod reserve 41 pct (CP 225).

arguments.message: leg 6 started: upwind and against current, push here

text: Cued a push (shaft back to 205 W, reserve refilling under the corrected critical power); noted the southerly wind and set a watch for the upwind leg 6 start.

arguments.text: 29.2 min: boat-speed reserve reads 1 pct only because the tailwind inflates speed_water (push_local 0.31 vs fitted 0.20): IGNORE boat reserve now, use pod (54 pct, CP 225). Last push cue had no effect (shaft 203-206). Saving cues for leg 6 upwind (watch leg6_upwind) and the finish.

text: no cue: tailwind leg, boat-speed reserve reading is distorted by the wind; pod reserve 54 pct; saving the next push for the upwind leg 6.

arguments.text: Headwind leg. Dig in here and chase 2:36 pace.

31.2 min, 6273 m, leg 6 upwind: shaft had drifted to 199 W, pod reserve 62 pct (CP 225), paddler 5/10 plenty. Cued push with ground pace 156 at 31.2 min. finish_zone watch fires at 6900 m: plan finish cue ~7100-7250 m (1500-1650 left) so part of the sprint is upwind; the 156 pace target must be overridden by the finish cue before the leg 7 turn (7500 m).

text: Cued a push with a 2:36 ground pace on the upwind, up-current leg, where extra effort buys the most time; paddler reports 5/10 with pod reserve 62 pct.

arguments.message: about 1600 m to the 8750 m finish: cue the final sprint now

arguments.text: Headwind hurts everyone. Keep the pressure on, sprint coming soon.

34.0 min, 6763 m: fade alert -4 pct is the headwind (push_local -0.46 vs fitted -0.28; a 10 kn headwind costs ~0.3 m/s), NOT rudder drag (drag_gap -0.18 > -0.25, shaft unchanged 204 W). Pod reserve 69 pct. Cued push 34.0 min. finish_zone watch moved to 7140 m: cue finish there (~1600 m left, ~350 m of it upwind).

text: Fade alert explained by the new headwind, not rudder drag; cued a push upwind and moved the finish watch to 1600 m out.

arguments.text: Go now! Final sprint, 1600 metres to the line.

36.3 min, 7143 m: cued FINISH (1607 m left, 357 m upwind then turn and 1250 m tailwind to 8750). Pod reserve 73 pct, shaft 208 W before. Watch for blow-up (shaft_drop < 192) and keep cues quiet unless they fade badly; none allowed in last 100 m.

text: Cued the final sprint at 1607 m to go, with pod reserve at 73 pct and part of it upwind.

arguments.text: 37.0 min, 7268 m: first FINISH cue (36.3 min) NOT followed: 1-s shaft 205-211 W, rate flat 60.5 for 40 s after. Re-cueing finish as soon as gate opens (~37.2 min). If still ignored, try push with a pace target after the leg 7 turn (7500 m, tailwind).
Sprint now! You have plenty left. Rate up, empty it.
Sprint now! You have plenty left. Rate up, empty it.

text: Re-cued the finish sprint because the first finish cue was not followed (shaft and rate flat); fade alert is the headwind.

arguments.text: Finish line is 900 metres ahead, at the end of this leg.

40.0 min, 7843 m (907 left): second finish cue also not followed (shaft 204-213, rate 60). Suspect paddler still believes finish at 10 km (tell at 24.4 min may not have registered). Re-told 885 m left at 40.0 min. Next (~41 min, ~680 left): finish cue, then push with pace ~132 (tailwind) if still flat. Pod reserve 78 pct, sustainable shaft 266 W.

arguments.message: cue gate open: check if paddler sprinting after the 885 m tell; if not, cue finish

text: Finish cues were ignored, so re-told the paddler the line is 885 m ahead (they may still think the race is 10 km); set a watch to follow up when the cue gate reopens.

arguments.text: 650 metres left. Everything now, chase 2:12 pace to the line.

arguments.message: cue gate open again: check sprint; if still flat try finish or rate_up

text: Paddler still flat at 200 W with 670 m left and 80 pct pod reserve; tried a push with a concrete 2:12 pace target instead of the ignored finish ask.

arguments.text: Yes! 400 metres, sprint all the way, empty the tank.

text: Paddler finally lifting (shaft 245 W, rate 64) with 438 m left and 75 pct pod reserve; cued finish to empty the tank.

arguments.message: cue gate open, last chance for a cue before the final 100 m

text: no cue (gate closed): fade alert compares sprint-rate strokes with the hard start, not a real fade; paddler sprinting at 247 W with reserve to spare; watch set for one last cue.

arguments.text: 200 to go! All out to the line!

text: Last cue before the final 100 m: all out to the line; did not clear the rudder since the speed shortfall in the sprint is as likely blade inefficiency at high rate as weed, and a back-stroke costs momentum with 200 m left.
